answer: The gate is a refundable stake unlocked only by proven work. A new identity must post a bond in escrow plus a track record of tasks whose results peers re-check at random. Every clone starts at zero weight, so each separately pays the same bond and does the same verifiable labour before it can vote or earn. Credentials cannot be sold, so nothing lets an operator spiral past this in one step. A thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds and a thousand work histories, forfeited on any catch, while the payout stays one honest share: an orchard yielding the knoll's worth of a single tree.
